headline: Strong Buy consensus, steady near highs
chart_note: 52-week range: $92.19 - $117.09. Currently $106.50, only about 9% below its high - one of the steadier names on the list.
why_today: Disney has quietly stabilized this year, trading in a relatively tight band near its 52-week high while streaming profitability improves and parks demand stays resilient. Analyst sentiment has turned notably more bullish than earlier in the year.
pro_1: 32 analysts rate it Strong Buy, with an average price target of $128 implying about 20% upside
pro_2: Pays a 1.41% dividend while trading near 52-week highs - a rare combination of income and momentum
con_1: PE of 22x isn't cheap for a media conglomerate facing ongoing linear-TV decline
con_2: Parks and streaming both remain sensitive to a broader consumer spending slowdown
